digest.component_or_area: bug lifecycle: transition/close with provenance auto-linking
propositions: Auto-derive a caused_by link on bug close by blame-resolving the culprit commit (>50% single-culprit threshold) against file_impact, over the pre-fix state, extracting the ticket via rebar-ticket: trailer; skip auto-derivation if no fixing-commit, no dominant commit, or no resolvable trailer.
Accept an explicit --caused-by <id> parameter on rebar transition to override or augment auto-derived caused_by links at close time.
Write caused_by links via _write_link_event directly, bypassing the closed-source guard, so the link succeeds after the bug is closed and committed.
Thread --caused-by end-to-end from transition_cli through transition_compute to close_ticket, and expose it in the public library facade transition() function.
Add a blame-hunt advisory to docs/user-guide.md guiding users on when auto-derivation applies and when to use --caused-by.
Treat blame-auto-derived caused_by edges as classified-confidence evidence (not authoritative), delegating confidence semantics to the consuming provenance metric.
